description: The GROUP_ORDER value in site/data/index.js -- one code per group-<code>.js file, in display order. Every other line in index.js is fixed loader boilerplate (identical shape across repos, not per-repo data), so this schema covers only the GROUP_ORDER array literal, not the whole file. Each code should also be the `num` a matching group-<code>.js assigns via group.schema.json.
